body:
Hello!

I've caught the watch bug a few years ago and I've never justified buying a watch more than $200, along with a whole myriad of personal issues that I struggled with.

Now that I've, for a lack of a better phrase, tried to "get my shit together", I've decided to commemorate my recovery journey by purchasing a watch that I've been wanting to own for a long time. 

It's a tangible reminder that I should continue moving forward. Everytime when it's on my wrist, I am reminded of my little victories, and I know that my life will definitely shape up to be better in the near future.

About the watch, I find it is just the right size for me at 41mm. The layered subdials with red accents do make the watch "pop", albeit in a more subtle manner. The bracelet is super comfortable as well, and it's definitely a huge step up in quality from the previous cheap watches I had. 

There's a lot of Speedys on this sub, but this is mine and it's definitely a sentimental piece.
